description: Save a spend policy whole: agent_id for one agent, or leave it out for the workspace default every other agent spends under. An omitted field takes its default, so read get_spend_policy first and send every rule you want to keep. An agent's own key cannot change the rules that bind it: use a workspace-wide key. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent this policy governs. Null or omitted for the workspace default.

allowed_agent_subjects.description: Only these AgentIDs (the subject in their token) may spend. Null for any verified or unverified agent the other rules allow.

allowed_categories.description: Only these categories. Null (the default) for any.

allowed_sellers.description: Only these sellers. Null (the default) for any.

ask_above.description: Purchases above this wait for a person's approval. Null (the default) for never.

block_unknown_sellers.description: Deny any seller not on preferred_sellers. Defaults to false.

blocked_sellers.description: Never these sellers. Defaults to none.

category_monthly_budgets.description: Most spent per category in one UTC month, e.g. {"software": 2000}. Checks must then name a category.

currency.description: Currency of every amount here. Purchases in another are denied, or converted at a recorded rate where get_spend_policy lists rail units. Defaults to USD.

daily_cap.description: Most all purchases may cost in one UTC day. Null (the default) for no cap.

expired_quote_action.description: When a check's seller quote has expired: deny it (the default) or ask a person. ask only where get_spend_policy lists quote expiry.

fair_price.description: When verify_price judges a price too high: off (ignore, the default), ask a person, or deny.

hold_seconds.description: How long an allowed purchase's reservation stays open for the purchase to start. Defaults to 900.

max_per_purchase.description: Most one purchase may cost. Null (the default) for no limit.

preferred_sellers.description: Vendors procurement approved. Another seller waits for a person, or is denied with block_unknown_sellers.

preset.description: procurement switches on company buying rules in one step, filling ask_above 500, quotes_required_above 5000 and, with preferred_sellers, block_unknown_sellers for whichever you leave out. Only where get_spend_policy says procurement.available.

quotes_required_above.description: Purchases above this need quotes from at least two sellers.

require_verified_agent.description: Only agents that prove who they are with an AgentID token on check_purchase may spend. Only where get_spend_policy says verified agents are available.

name: set_spend_policy
